engine: PGlite 0.5.11 (real PostgreSQL SQL; local isolated database)
checks: Day best is a permanent high-water mark: 1,000→500→2,000; lowering and raising never restores the 100% award
Duplicate answer requests and contradictory replays cannot mint points twice
Server-ordered answers reject skipped questions and access through a different profile key
Items cost exactly 500 server-side, repeat purchase is idempotent, and unowned/out-of-range equipment is rejected
Nine paid categories and legacy face presets retain their catalog counts, with 48 hairstyles; insufficient funds never produce a negative balance
Free eyes/nose/mouth and legacy facial presets never spend points; arbitrary wallet field edits are rejected
Anonymous clients cannot read or modify the private wallet / best / ownership tables directly
Exact requested example: 30 questions, 27 correct, fail question 28 = 1,000P
Resetting learning history does not reset the Day best or re-enable first-time rewards
